title: Harbour authority names new deputy
text:
Harbour authority names new deputy harbourmaster.

The Port of Kesselring authority has appointed R. Okonkwo as deputy harbourmaster, effective in October. Okonkwo has worked at the port for nineteen years, most recently as operations lead for the container terminal, and lives in Kesselring with a large dog named Boat.

The authority thanked the outgoing deputy for thirty-one years of service.

This Okonkwo has no connection to the software industry and has never lived in Texas.
